name: Lost Your Marbles
source:
Lost Your Marbles is a charming visual novel where the roll of a marble makes all the difference. Join PROTA in this branching-narrative adventure as she makes her way through Pomegranate Village on a quest to find her lost dog MINTY and make it to the annual Festi-Ball before day's end.

[From the [url=https://play.date/games/lost-your-marbles/]Playdate website[/url]]
translation:
《Lost Your Marbles》是一部迷人的视觉小说，一颗弹珠的滚动便足以改变一切。与PROTA一起踏上这段拥有分支剧情的冒险，穿行于石榴村，寻找走失的爱犬MINTY，并在天黑前赶上每年一度的Festi-Ball庆典。

[摘自[url=https://play.date/games/lost-your-marbles/]Playdate website[/url]]
